name: Alice's Day Off
source:
Heart's Day is here again!

Play as the entrepreneurial witch cat Alice as she tries to unload some rare, magical, and only slightly illegal sex toys.

And hey, while you're at it, why not sleep with everyone who walks in the door?  They're coming into a sex shop, right?  They're probably already horny.  How could you possibly fuck this up?

[From [url=https://floraverse.itch.io/alices-day-off-demo]itch.io[/url]]
